record.label: Edgeworth weight-order extension probe
record.summary: Adjudicated at design stage by exact synthetic flopscope billing, with no source build and no data access. The L5 group is not implementable (the host carries no fifth-order cumulant state). Every implementable lambda-cubed Edgeworth channel group exceeds the exact 2^41 headroom at the current host total: L3*L4 needs 69,547,720,704 added FLOPs over fourteen layers against a 66,547,897,095 headroom including the J correction, L3^3 needs 86,934,650,880, and both together 156,482,371,584 - before counting weight-construction cost. Together with the T closure, the series-refinement family is measured out: within the budget the Q24 closure's expansion orders sit at their cost frontier and the sub-leading terms that fit do not matter.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed on cost under exact billing; no scope variant. The sole licensed successor is the host compute-value attribution design P2R0F2V, which asks whether any existing component's budget could fund the L3*L4 shell.
